name: Position-dependent Transfer Function Customization
aliases: Interactive Position-dependent Customization of Transfer Function Classification Parameters
definition: A method for interactive position-dependent customization of arbitrary parameters of the transfer function classification in volume rendering, allowing local adaptations of visualization parameters based on voxel position without preprocessing.
summary: Position-dependent Transfer Function Customization is an interactive method that modifies visualization parameters at specific 3D locations using a customization volume, preserving spatial context without preprocessing.
